_doc: THIS FILE DECIDES WHO IS ELIGIBLE. The LLM never does.
Every rule carries source_doc / source_url / source_quote -- that citation is what
the 'Why?' panel shows. A rule you cannot cite is a rule you cannot defend, so the
quote must be checkable against the URL rather than paraphrased from memory.
Every rule that CAN be fixed by an action carries a `remedy`. The Ladder can only
offer what is written here, so a rule without a remedy is a dead end and a rule with
one is a rung. Age and income carry no remedy on purpose -- you cannot act your way
`depends_on` lists rule ids whose remedies must be completed FIRST. You cannot get a
UPI ID without a bank account, and you cannot open a Jan Dhan account without Aadhaar.
Without this the ladder sorts by cost and hands someone an order they cannot follow.
Ops: eq ne gt gte lt lte in not_in contains contains_any not_contains is_true is_false
A rule whose field is absent from the profile evaluates to None -> NEED_INFO, never fail.

schemes.name: PM SVANidhi
schemes.benefit_summary: Collateral-free working capital loan in three tranches -- Rs 10,000, then Rs 20,000, then Rs 50,000 -- with a 7% annual interest subsidy and up to Rs 1,200 a year cashback for digital transactions.

rules.description: Applicant must be a street vendor
rules.source_quote: The scheme is available to street vendors engaged in vending in urban areas as on or before 24 March 2020.

rules.description: Must hold a Certificate of Vending or a Letter of Recommendation from the Town Vending Committee
rules.source_quote: Applicants must hold a Certificate of Vending or vendor identity card issued by the Urban Local Body. Vendors left out of the survey may obtain a Letter of Recommendation from the ULB or Town Vending Committee.

remedy.action: Request a Letter of Recommendation from your Town Vending Committee at the ULB office
remedy.where: Urban Local Body / Town Vending Committee office

rules.description: Aadhaar is required for loan application and subsidy transfer
rules.source_quote: The loan is open to Indian citizens aged 18 years or above with a bank account linked to an Aadhaar-verified mobile number.

remedy.action: Enrol for Aadhaar at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra
remedy.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Common Service Centre

rules.description: A bank account is required to receive the loan
rules.source_quote: The loan is open to Indian citizens aged 18 years or above with a bank account linked to an Aadhaar-verified mobile number. Loan proceeds and the 7% interest subsidy are credited directly to that account.

remedy.action: Open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account using your Aadhaar
remedy.where: Any public sector bank branch or Bank Mitra

rules.description: An existing loan written off as NPA disqualifies; merely holding a loan does not
rules.source_quote: Applicants whose earlier loans have been classified as non-performing assets are not eligible until the account is regularised.

rules.description: Must have been vending on or before 24 March 2020
rules.source_quote: PM SVANidhi covers vendors who were in business on or before 24 March 2020.

schemes.name: PM-SYM
schemes.benefit_summary: A guaranteed pension of Rs 3,000 a month after age 60. The government matches your contribution rupee for rupee.

rules.description: Entry age must be between 18 and 40
rules.source_quote: The entry age of the beneficiary shall be between 18 and 40 years.

rules.description: Entry age must not exceed 40
rules.source_quote: The entry age of the beneficiary shall be between 18 and 40 years.

rules.description: Monthly income must not exceed Rs 15,000
rules.source_quote: Monthly income of the unorganised worker should be Rs 15,000 or less.

rules.description: Must not be a member of EPFO, ESIC or NPS
rules.source_quote: Applicants should not be covered under the New Pension Scheme, the Employees' State Insurance Corporation scheme, or the Employees' Provident Fund Organisation.

rules.description: Must not be an income tax payer
rules.source_quote: The worker should not be an income tax payer.

rules.description: A savings bank account is required for auto-debit of contributions
rules.source_quote: The beneficiary should possess a savings bank account and an Aadhaar number.

remedy.action: Open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account using your Aadhaar
remedy.where: Any public sector bank branch or Bank Mitra

rules.description: Aadhaar is required for enrolment
rules.source_quote: The beneficiary should possess a savings bank account and an Aadhaar number.

remedy.action: Enrol for Aadhaar at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra
remedy.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Common Service Centre

schemes.name: e-Shram
schemes.full_name: e-Shram National Database of Unorganised Workers
schemes.benefit_summary: Free registration giving you a Universal Account Number, Rs 2 lakh accidental death cover for the first year, and automatic consideration for future welfare schemes.

rules.description: Must be at least 16
rules.source_quote: Any unorganised worker aged between 16 and 59 years may register on the e-Shram portal.

rules.description: Must be 59 or younger
rules.source_quote: Any unorganised worker aged between 16 and 59 years may register on the e-Shram portal.

rules.description: Must not be a member of EPFO or ESIC
rules.source_quote: The worker must not be a member of EPFO/ESIC or NPS (Government funded).

rules.description: Aadhaar linked to a mobile number is required
rules.source_quote: An Aadhaar linked mobile number is required by the worker to register on the e-Shram portal. Workers without one may register through biometric authentication at a Common Service Centre.

remedy.action: Enrol for Aadhaar at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra
remedy.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Common Service Centre

rules.description: Must not be an income tax payer
rules.source_doc: e-Shram FAQs, Ministry of Labour & Employment
rules.source_quote: The worker should not be an income tax payee.

schemes.name: PMJJBY
schemes.full_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 2 lakh life insurance cover for a premium of Rs 436 a year, auto-debited from your bank account.

rules.description: Must be at least 18
rules.source_quote: Available to savings bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years.

rules.description: Entry age must not exceed 50
rules.source_quote: Anyone between the ages of 18 and 50 with a savings account at a bank or post office can take part, at a yearly premium of Rs 436.

rules.description: A savings bank account with auto-debit consent is required
rules.source_quote: The scheme is offered to individual savings bank account holders who give consent to auto-debit of premium.

remedy.action: Open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account using your Aadhaar
remedy.where: Any public sector bank branch or Bank Mitra

rules.description: Aadhaar is the primary KYC for the bank account
rules.source_quote: Aadhaar shall be the primary KYC for the bank account.

remedy.action: Enrol for Aadhaar at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra
remedy.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Common Service Centre

schemes.name: PMSBY
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 2 lakh accidental death cover, or Rs 1 lakh for partial disability, for a premium of Rs 20 a year.

rules.description: Must be at least 18
rules.source_quote: Available to savings bank account holders aged 18 to 70 years.

rules.description: Must be 70 or younger
rules.source_quote: PMSBY provides accidental death and disability cover up to Rs 2 lakh to persons aged between 18 and 70 years, at a premium of less than Rs 2 per month.

rules.description: A savings bank account with auto-debit consent is required
rules.source_quote: The scheme is offered to individual savings bank account holders who give consent to auto-debit of premium.

remedy.action: Open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account using your Aadhaar
remedy.where: Any public sector bank branch or Bank Mitra

schemes.name: PM Vishwakarma
schemes.benefit_summary: Rs 15,000 toolkit incentive, free skill training with a daily stipend, and collateral-free loans of Rs 1 lakh then Rs 2 lakh at 5% interest.

rules.description: Must work in one of the 18 recognised traditional trades
rules.source_quote: The applicant should be working in one of the 18 trade categories listed under the scheme, working with hands and tools in the unorganised sector.

rules.description: Must be at least 18 on the date of registration
rules.source_quote: Applicants must be 18 years of age or older on the date of registration.

rules.description: Aadhaar-based biometric registration is required
rules.source_quote: Registration is done through Aadhaar-based biometric authentication at a Common Service Centre.

remedy.action: Enrol for Aadhaar at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra
remedy.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Common Service Centre

rules.description: An existing loan written off as NPA disqualifies
rules.source_quote: Beneficiaries with loans classified as non-performing assets shall not be eligible for credit support.

rules.description: Must not have taken a loan under a similar central credit scheme (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi) in the last 5 years
rules.source_doc: PM Vishwakarma Scheme Guidelines, Ministry of MSME
rules.source_quote: The beneficiary should not have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes of Central or State Government such as PMEGP or PM SVANidhi in the past 5 years.

schemes.name: Atal Pension Yojana
schemes.benefit_summary: A guaranteed pension of Rs 1,000 to Rs 5,000 a month after age 60, depending on how much you contribute.

rules.description: Entry age must be at least 18
rules.source_quote: Any citizen of India aged between 18 and 40 years with a savings bank account may join.

rules.description: Entry age must not exceed 40
rules.source_quote: Any citizen of India aged between 18 and 40 years with a savings bank account may join.

rules.description: Income tax payers have not been eligible to join since 1 October 2022
rules.source_quote: With effect from 1 October 2022, any citizen who is or has been an income tax payer shall not be eligible to join the scheme.

rules.description: A savings bank account is required for auto-debit of contributions
rules.source_quote: The applicant must have a savings bank account with auto-debit facility for monthly contributions.

remedy.action: Open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account using your Aadhaar
remedy.where: Any public sector bank branch or Bank Mitra

schemes.name: MUDRA Shishu
schemes.benefit_summary: Collateral-free business loan up to Rs 50,000 for a small non-farm enterprise.

rules.description: Must be at least 18
rules.source_quote: The applicant should be at least 18 years of age.

rules.description: Annual turnover must be within the micro-enterprise ceiling of Rs 5 lakh for Shishu
rules.source_quote: Loans up to Rs 50,000 are available under the 'Shishu' category, for non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.

rules.description: A bank account is required for disbursal
rules.source_quote: Loan amounts are credited to the borrower's bank account.

remedy.action: Open a zero-balance Jan Dhan account using your Aadhaar
remedy.where: Any public sector bank branch or Bank Mitra

rules.description: Aadhaar is required as KYC
rules.source_quote: Aadhaar is accepted as officially valid KYC documentation for the loan application.

remedy.action: Enrol for Aadhaar at the nearest Aadhaar Seva Kendra
remedy.where: Aadhaar Seva Kendra / Common Service Centre

rules.description: An existing loan written off as NPA disqualifies
rules.source_quote: Borrowers classified as non-performing assets with any lending institution are not eligible.
